$comment: Fixture CANVAS contract for contract-diff.mjs --self-test — paired with diff-code-sample.contract.json. Plants: (1) no 'Full Width' component property, so code's fullWidth prop is missing-in-canvas; (2) an extra 'Quaternary' Variant option code doesn't have, so the axis is a variant-value mismatch; (3) no bound variables at all, so code's one token binding is missing-in-canvas; (4) no 'State' variant axis, WITH the matching degradation recorded — code declares 4 states, and the differ must SKIP the state dimension rather than report 4 missing-in-canvas disagreements.
degradations: props[].bindings.code — canvas has no code attribute names; see componentProperties for the Figma-side property list only.
events, slots — not representable in a Figma component set.
a11y.{ariaAttributes,cssParts} — ARIA attributes and CSS parts are code (CEM) facts; no accessibility read is performed from canvas.
semantics.role — no live accessibility-tree read is performed from canvas.

anatomy.*.tokens — canvas resolves Figma bound-VARIABLE NAMES only (see anatomy.*.boundVariables); it cannot know which `--al-*` custom property a variable maps to in code (see scripts/figma-atoms/token-map.mjs for that side).
bindings.code — no code binding is derivable from canvas alone.
states — no "State" variant axis found on this set.
